title: Turning tracking off keeps every bin quantity
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test with 4 in bin location A and 3 in bin location B.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the part A row.
  2. Click the Track quantities and cost of goods switch.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the part A row again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens with both bins: bin location A with 4 and bin location B with 3.

Step 2:

  • The switch turns off and both bin rows are still shown with their quantities, 4 and 3.

Step 3:

  • Part A's Bin Location / Quantity cell still shows bin location A with 4 and bin location B with 3 (4 + 3 = 7 still on the shelf; nothing was set to zero).

Step 4:

  • The window shows the switch off and the same two bins, 4 and 3.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10818 (Story 5, Change Tracking on an Existing Part)

  • S5-R3: “Turning tracking off hides Min and Max in the part dialog. It does not change the quantity in any bin.”
  • S5-R3a: “The bin locations and their quantities stay visible in the part dialog, as a shelf reference (S4-R6).”
